verdict.rationale: Proton Pass documents a built-in export so you can use your passwords elsewhere. It offers three open formats: a PGP-encrypted JSON ZIP, an unencrypted ZIP, and CSV. The official CLI can also read items across all vaults for scripted extraction. missing for 10: evidence that the export covers all data types (file attachments, passkeys, aliases, TOTP secrets), independent or hands-on confirmation that the export is complete, and documentation of the account-leaving/deletion step.
